source.handling: Read locally only. Original certificate unchanged; not a public website asset.
source.verification: Matched the enterprise name, Mobile, Email, City or District, and State labels in the locally extracted PDF text. Full certificate text was not written or printed.

excluded_from_website: Proprietor or other personal identity details
Street or home address and precise location details
Registration identifiers, QR codes and certificate image or PDF
Enterprise classification and registration or commencement years
Any inference of tourism accreditation, service capability, trading history or customer trust from this registration document
exclusion_rationale: The homepage only needs the supplied public brand, contact channels and broad city/state. Other certificate information is unnecessary for this design scope and may disclose personal data or imply unverified business claims.
